title: YouCoded theme — Glow and Silk together

steps.path: The picture behind everything: YouCoded on top, YouCoded Night underneath
steps.headline: Glow and Silk combined at three strengths. Which one?

variants.label: Calm
variants.summary: Glow underneath, ribbons in three depths (wide and soft far back, thin and bright in front) with a fine sheen; the softest of the three.

variants.label: Richer
variants.summary: The same picture with deeper colour and fuller ribbons.

variants.label: Strongest
variants.summary: The most colour and the boldest ribbons.
variants.risk: Behind see-through panels, the brightest ribbons can pull the eye from the chat.
